bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Collie (Rough) social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Collie (Rough) exposure.
Weight range 50-75 lb (23-34 kg) and grooming needs (Long coat daily care.) belong in the same Collie (Rough) household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Collie (Rough) is also monitored for collie eye anomaly, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Collie (Rough) appointments.
After the Collie (Rough) puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Collie (Rough) misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Collie (Rough) series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Collie (Rough) is the gap, not the embarrassment, because parvovirus pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated puppy even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up DA2PP / DHPP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Collie (Rough) away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Collie (Rough) due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Collie (Rough) core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Collie (Rough) misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Collie (Rough) health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Collie (Rough) adult health guide for breed predispositions such as mdr1 drug sensitivity, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
